title: A check-only date can validate a body never downloaded
reproduction: An enabled list was fetched yesterday with no ETag. A check records today's newer Last-Modified. Build the following GET.
expected: Fetch the newer body before accepting a 304 for its date.
observed: The actual pre-fix request sent If-Modified-Since equal to the new revision. A date-conditional server can therefore return 304 and leave old rules active.
fix: Use HostsSource.hasNewerOnlineCopy() to force a fresh request; preserve validators for an already-fetched revision.
test_evidence: Host regression failed before and passed after; unchanged control passed. MockWebServer HEAD/GET/GET and active-rule assertions compiled, not run.
